notes.title: Epsilon Protocol is heading to Tokyo Game Show 2025!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Rebellion,[/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce that [i]Epsilon Protocol[/i] will be showcased at [b]Tokyo Game Show 2025[/b]! 🎉[/p][p]Our squad of misfits and rebels are packing their flamethrowers, turrets, and teleporters to bring chaotic tactics gameplay to Tokyo. Expect explosions, banter, and plenty of comic-book energy. 🔥[/p][p]📍 If you’re at TGS, visit us at the [b]GDAI India Pavilion[/b] (Hall 11, Booth E27) to play the latest demo!
🌍 If you can’t make it, stay tuned — we’ll be sharing updates, gameplay clips, and behind-the-scenes stories.[/p][p]🙏 Huge thanks to our partners [b]Game Developers Association of India (GDAI)[/b] and [b]WAVES Bazaar[/b] for helping make this showcase possible.[/p][p]— The RIGS Team[/p][p]#TokyoGameShow #TGS2025 #EpsilonProtocol #TurnBasedTactics #IndieGames #GDAI #WAVESBazaar[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137550/ab95334f521850d4185c237433a8b6889c157e9a.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Epsilon Protocol is featured on MGN 2025 Steam Sale!
notes.notes:
Epsilon Protocol is officially one of the featured games at MGN 2025, and we’re beyond honored.

We’ve poured our hearts, late nights, and questionable code into this, and it means the world to see it get this spotlight.

notes.title: Comic Con x Indie Game Utsav Sale, featuring Epsilon Protocol
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are glad to announce Epsilon Protocol's participation in the Comic Con x Indie Game Utsav Steam sale!


The sale includes over a 100 Games being showcased! The top indie developers from across the country are coming together and this event is connecting them with top global publishers who are looking to partner.

This also gives Indian gamers a chance to experience the best homegrown games.

It runs from 10th to 20th of April on Steam and Its also happening under the same roof as Mumbai Comic Con on 12th and 13th of April where you can see and experience some of these games LIVE and talk to the developers✨

Try our demo and wishlist the game

Thank you!
